limitations: Artificial receipt values and posterior summaries are hand-constructed; no posterior fitting, world realization, environment response, teacher label or evaluation has occurred.
Public validation checks dimensions, finite values, positive-semidefinite covariance and history accounting; it does not certify posterior consistency with these histories.

The prospective Gaussian law has no finite scientific magnitude cap. Intervention bounds [-2,2] constrain clamps, not free observations or posterior means. Binary64 extremes are serialization probes, not plausible predictions or stable learner-update inputs.

Long spellings are longest only within the declared finite value corpus. This finite fixture does not cover all real values, all accepted JSON numbers, all token segmentations, or all histories. Generic APIs also accept text/counters outside this proposal's fixed design.

A valid 32-row history exhausts budget 32; all eight actions plus stop are instead tested at 31 rows for uniform cost and 30 rows for heterogeneous cost. Mixed histories exercise all action/clamp forms while respecting the eight initial observations and cost budget.
Byte/character counts are not token counts or resource predictions. Every future real prompt still requires untruncated validation; fixture success is not universal admission.
